name: Lys Hartwick
source_profile:
Lys Hartwick (CN) — Proprietor of the Black Lantern

Lys is a former prospector who arrived in Blackvein years before the Edict of the East, spent several seasons searching unsuccessfully for gold, and eventually discovered that selling drink to successful miners was considerably more profitable than joining them.

An affable but calculating woman, Lys has become one of the town's most recognizable personalities. Her saloon attracts miners, prospectors, merchants, gamblers, and occasional outlaws, providing her with an extensive network of acquaintances throughout the settlement.

Lys maintains friendly relations with Sheriff Lorne and generally cooperates with her investigations, provided doing so does not threaten the confidence of her regular customers. She is considerably less fond of the Iron Spurs, whose patrols sometimes disrupt business and whose officers rarely appreciate her habit of treating official proclamations as subjects for public ridicule.
